estimates.massReason: One 75 kg occupant. Equipped base includes fuel/fluids; dry base adds the stated fuel and other fluids. Fuel quantities, density and fluids are game estimates, not measured capacities.
estimates.cgReason: K decision (2026-09-25): provisional gameplay CG height = wheelbase * 0.3 for every bike. This represents the complete running rigid body, including occupant and fuel; it is not a measured or mass-weighted physical estimate.
estimates.geometryReason: Published wheelbase preserves the previous front/rear axle fraction. Named tire sizes use nominal unloaded radius; other effective radii remain provisional.
estimates.curveReason: Idle torque retained. Peak-power torque = watts / angular speed. Redline torque follows slope -1.1 * peak-power torque / peak-power RPM to keep power falling throughout the final linear interval.
